inputs.text: The real test of any ceasefire is whether it protects civilians and prevents more violence—not whether Israel retains room to use force. The US should not use its influence to entrench a power imbalance or turn security concerns around the Strait of Hormuz into an excuse to shut down negotiations. A lasting settlement must prioritize people on all sides, not simply preserve governments’ ability to escalate.
